title: nan
authors: Lai J.; Bai S.; Xu X.; Lü P.
key_contribution: Presents a generic plug-and-play navigation fusion strategy using improved factor graph optimization for land vehicles in GNSS-denied environments, validated experimentally with multiple sensor configurations.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
